issue.title: Feature: GitHub becomes a library client
issue.body:
Design: `docs/design-history/2026-08-05-coding-agents-and-tools.md`. Target branch: `local-client-greenfield`.

GitHub read/write moves into `crates/epik` as a hand-rolled client — REST for the ordinary verbs, GraphQL for the relationship mutations (sub-issues, blocked-by) that never got REST endpoints. `gh` and MCP wrappers leave the app. The client's token rides the `keystore.rs` rails as a second entry kind.

Sub-issues: the token; the client.

Acceptance: using `epik` library calls alone — read an issue graph including sub-issue and blocked-by edges; create, edit, comment on, and close issues; open and merge PRs; read check conclusions and the default branch. Token absence is a typed refusal, never a panic or a prose log line. No `gh` invocation anywhere in the library or hosts.
